verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://docs.airweave.ai/llms.txt, which contains an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' section telling agents to append `.md` to any page URL for clean Markdown. Every docs page in the pack is served as `.md`, and Airweave also publishes official agent skills so coding agents can work without repeated explanation. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using llms.txt, and evidence of a full-content variant such as llms-full.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote:
## Instructions for AI Agents

- For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL

Airweave publishes official skills so that agents in Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and other environments can set up integrations and search your data without you having to explain how every time.
